data.name: Grand Luau (16-36 people)
data.headline: Starting at $110 Per Person • 3 Hrs • 50ft Party Boat • 18-36 People • Price includes a bar package
data.description:
Embarks & Disembarks from our Monroe Harbor dock

You may request a Riverwalk departure or end (if schedule permits)

Available for Chicago River and Lake (skyline) charters

Includes open bar service (Cozumel Package)

#Features#
- Two decks
- Full Tiki-bar
- Fusion Sound system (Bluetooth)

#Special Feature#
- Water Slide

#Swimming Allowed (lake only / weather permitting)#

- Please arrive at least 30 minutes before boarding time
- Boarding begins at the designated boarding time.
- Illegal Drugs and weapons (of any kind) are not allowed aboard the vessel
- All bags are subject to search
- No outside drinks are allowed aboard (NO BYOB)
- Wear comfortable shoes
data.cancellation_notes:
#CHARTER CANCELLATION POLICY#
- Cancellations and refund requests must be made in writing to ALOHA@ISLANDPARTYBOAT.COM
- Cancellations must be received more than 21 days before the time of the outing
- 50% fee on all cancellations. (fee based on 50% of full price, not deposit.)
- Cancellations (including no-shows for any reason) within 21 days of outing forfeit all funds paid.
- Rescheduling requests must be made in writing to ALOHA@ISLANDPARTYBOAT.COM
- Rescheduling requests must be received more than 21 days before the time of the outing
- 50% fee on all rescheduling requests. (fee based on 50% of full price, not deposit.)
- Cancellations due to weather conditions, mechanical or other reasons are determined dockside the day of the charter, entirely at the discretion of the Captain, and will result in full credit or refund.
- We sell charters, not the weather; our vessels go out rain or shine.

#TICKET CANCELLATION POLICY#
- All Tickets are non-refundable.
- Cancellations due to weather conditions, mechanical or other reasons are determined dockside the day of the ticketed cruise, entirely at the discretion of the Captain, and will result in full credit or refund.
